# HexPiece 3.6.0

Your Haki requests from the last chat: your own Haki and Ryou colours, one crooked lightning everywhere, the coat higher up the arm,
and new lightning sounds. Not tested in game yet: the build, the tests and the previews pass.

**Pick your Haki colour and your Ryou colour.** The start menu has two new pages after the fighting style.
- **Haki colour** (the lightning): Black and Red, Gold and Yellow, Purple, Green, Blue, Green, Cyan and Black, Red and Light Red. Each
  card shows a bolt in that colour, drawn the way the game draws it.
- **Ryou colour** (the glow round your coated arms): Red & Orange, Purple & Black, Green, Pink, Red & Yellow, Blue, Gold. Each card
  shows a coated fist in its glow.
- If you already set sail before this version, the game opens just these two pages for you once when you join, so you can pick. Every
  colour is named by its colours only.

**One Haki lightning, thin and crooked, shooting out every way.** Every Haki lightning in the game is now the Conqueror's release
lightning (G): the same black body and coloured rim, in your Haki colour. That includes your Haki-coated hits with fruits and fighting
styles, the sparks off your body and your blade, WiFi Haki's crackle and the original mod's own Haki effects.
- It is about a quarter as thick as before (the release's bolts were up to almost 3 blocks wide; now well under one block), and a bolt
  passing close to your camera is drawn thinner still, so it never covers the screen.
- Each bolt shoots straight out and zig-zags sharply either side of its line (no more bolts turning back and tangling into knots).
- The release now throws its bolts all round you by thirds: out level at chest height (the middle was always empty before), up into
  the sky, and down to tear the ground. A move's Haki lightning out of its blast does the same.

**The coat goes past the elbow.** Armament Haki now covers the forearm up past the elbow, with an uneven, ragged edge (no straight line),
and the Ryou glow fades out gently up the arm instead of stopping short.

**New lightning sounds, quieter, one at a time.**
- Every Haki lightning sound is a new bass-heavy thunder recording from the web (free to use, credited in the files): the release's
  strike, the short Haki zaps (coated hits, sparks, landings, crackles) and the storm's thunder. All of them are quieter than the old
  ones (6 dB quieter at their loudest). Only the lightning sounds changed: the release's explosion and every other sound are as
  they were.
- Only one lightning sound plays at a time now. When a lightning sound is playing, no other lightning sound starts on top of it, so
  letting go of a full Conqueror's charge is heard as one strike (with its explosion), not a pile of thunders at once. The full release
  plays that one new strike where its old snap was.

Update both the server and every client together (the network version changed).
